passage:
At David's house, there was one rule about sandwiches: if you made one, you had to clean the table afterward.
David often forgot. He left bread bags open, cheese on the table, and crumbs everywhere. His sister, Emma, always complained.
One Saturday, their mother said she would not remind anyone anymore. David made a sandwich and left the kitchen. Later, he came back for another one and found ants on the table.
He was shocked. Emma looked at him and said, "The ants followed your rule better than you did. They came after the sandwich."
David spent half an hour cleaning. After that day, he remembered the sandwich rule. He learned that small messes do not always stay small.
